ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given symbols: Europa has mass m, circular orbital radius r, orbital period T, and gravitational constant G. Treat Jupiter as the central mass M and Europa as undergoing uniform circular motion. Europa's centripetal acceleration is a_c = 4π²r/T². The gravitational force from Jupiter is GMm/r², and this supplies the centripetal force m a_c = m(4π²r/T²). Setting GMm/r² = m(4π²r/T²), cancel m and solve for M: M = 4π²r³/(GT²).

method.method_draft: Read the given symbols: Europa has mass m, circular orbital radius r, orbital period T, and gravitational constant G; the requested unknown is Jupiter's mass M. Treat Jupiter as the central body and Europa as moving in uniform circular motion. Compute Europa's centripetal acceleration as a_c = 4π^2 r / T^2. Set the gravitational force from Jupiter, G M m / r^2, equal to the required centripetal force, m a_c = m(4π^2 r / T^2). Cancel Europa's mass m and solve for M to obtain M = 4π^2 r^3 / (G T^2).
